items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:28:1
items.html: The light of the ZAT, which took only from the Guf downward, that is, from the end of the Shibolet HaZakan downward: As written above (page 410, the passage beginning “And the third phase”). For the ZAT take from the discernment of the corrections of the Dikna [beard] that are beneath the Shibolet [the strand of the beard], since the light of the Ozen [ear] does not reach there, for it ends at the Shibolet HaZakan. And see above (page 411, the passage beginning “The light of the Ozen”).

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 6:28:2
items.html:
And the arms of his hands were made supple, which is the secret of the ten drops that were cast from between the nails. And although he says below that the ten vapours came out through the nails of the feet, how does he say here that they are from the hands? However, what is said, that the ZAT took from the vapours that come out through the nails of the feet, means that they took from the discernment of the Parsa that concludes at the feet of SAG, and it turns out thereby that they took from the nails of the feet. And you must remember what was written above (in the Inner Light, page 401, the passage beginning “Parsa”), that the meaning of this Parsa is the discernment of the new point of restriction, which passed from the place of the Malchut of the ten Sefirot of the Sium to the place of the Bina of the ten Sefirot of the Sium. And just as the place of the conclusion of the line in the first restriction of Ein Sof was in the Malchut of the ten Sefirot of the Sium, which is literally this world, in the secret of the verse, “And His feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives,” so now, in the second restriction, which is called the restriction of NHY of AK, the point of the Sium was made in the Bina of these ten Sefirot, which is called the point of the world to come. And here the Parsa was spread out, which concludes at the new boundary made in the worlds, where the feet of the Partzuf SAG of AK end; and the discernment of the Parsa is regarded as the discernment of the nails of the feet of SAG of AK. And remember this.
And it was explained in the Inner Light above (page 411, the passage beginning “And there is another reason”), (45) that the Parsa and the Shibolet HaZakan are one and the same matter. Study it there well. And this is what the ARI says here, that only two vapours came out from the Yesod of AK, corresponding to the Hotem [nose] and the Peh [mouth], from which the upper AVI received, and the vapour corresponding to the light of the Ozen is missing; and therefore the ZAT took from the nails of the feet, for they took from the end of the Shibolet, which concludes the light of the Ozen. And you will understand that because of the new point of the Sium, three discernments of Sium emerged in SAG, in its Rosh [head], Toch and Sof: the point of the Sium of the Rosh is called the Nikvey Einayim; the point of the Sium of the Toch, (46) which is in the place of the former Tabur, is called the Shibolet HaZakan; and the discernment of the Sium of the Sof is called Parsa. Thus the Parsa is the discernment of the toes of the feet of SAG of AK.
However, all this that we discern in SAG of AK changes nothing in the essence of the Partzuf SAG itself, for you already know that there is no absence and no change in spirituality, and all that we discern in it is only in the manner of a root (as above, page 392, the passage beginning “And here”). Rather, all these changes that are made by the force of the new point of restriction are only in that new Partzuf that emerged by reason of the joining of phase four with phase two, through the Nikvey Einayim, which is called the Partzuf of Nekudim. And only in the RTS [Rosh-Toch-Sof] of this Partzuf did the three above Parsaot actually emerge and come into being, in its Rosh, Toch and Sof. And remember this.
And you already know that this Parsa contains a great correction, that it draws from above and gives below, because it is a discernment of a screen doubled from two phases, from phase two and from phase four together. This came about because of the ascent of NHY to HGT, and phase two, which operates in HGT in the Partzuf SAG, became included with phase four, which operates in the NHY of the inner AK, as above, page 390, the passage beginning “And SAG.” See there. Therefore the Parsa stands diagonally from the Chazeh [chest] to the Tabur, since it includes within it NHY and HGT together. And therefore, at the time of the Gadlut [greatness/adulthood], the bottom Hey, which is phase four, descends from the Parsa, and the Parsa is breached — meaning that the concluding boundary is annulled — and then the lights of SAG pass below the Parsa, as above (page 403, the passage beginning “The Parsa.” See there). And immediately after this the Parsa returns to its place. And thereby (47) the Parsa draws from above the illumination of SAG and gives below to the Partzuf of Nekudim that is below the Tabur. And in the same way also in the Partzufim of Atzilut, in the manner that will be explained there.
Therefore those seven Sefirot of the Nekudim that could not receive any light from SAG because of the Sium of the Parsa — now, at the time of the Gadlut, after the Parsa has been breached, they too receive light from the place of the Parsa, where the discernment of SAG and HGT of the general AK is. Thus those lights that the seven lower Sefirot of the Nekudim received from the Parsa are the discernment of HGT, which are the arms of the hands. And therefore it is said, “and the arms of his hands were made supple.” Understand this well.
Now it has been explained that before the coupling of the Gadlut, the Parsa is regarded as the toes of the feet of the Partzuf SAG, since the illumination of SAG ends there, and the end of the illumination is called the feet. But at the time when the Parsa is breached, when the boundary returns to the point of the Sium of this world as before, (48) the discernment of HGT expands as before.
